create.name: Mary-Anne Kennedy
create.bio:
Mary-Anne Kennedy is a Canadian spiritual medium and teacher. Before turning to mediumship full time she taught environmental science and technology at college level, and that background shapes the structured, step-by-step way she trains students. She founded the online School of Mediumship & Spiritual Studies, has taught as guest faculty at the Lily Dale Assembly in New York State and on The Shift Network, and is a Reiki Master/Teacher. She is also the on-screen medium in Ghosts of Dufferin County & Beyond, a series made for Rogers Television.

Her work centres on evidential mediumship: helping people sense, read and pass on messages from loved ones who have died, while staying grounded and protected. Students can work through her self-paced certificate courses in mediumship, intuition, energy protection and Reiki, join live Zoom groups, or take her six-week Soul-Connect Coaching programme, which looks at the patterns and beliefs that hold people back. She gives private readings, including spiritual guidance and Akashic Records sessions, by video call, and leads public demonstrations at events across Ontario. Her books are How to Become a Medium (2015), a beginner's guide with exercises, and Advanced Mediumship (2023), written for working mediums.

books.title: How to Become a Medium: A Step-by-Step Guide to Connecting with the Other Side
books.author: Mary-Anne Kennedy
books.description: Her first book, a practical introduction for beginners. It explains how spirit communication works, sets out a path of exercises from a first meditation practice to reading for others, and draws on stories from her own readings.

books.title: Advanced Mediumship: A Masterful Guide for the Practicing Medium
books.author: Mary-Anne Kennedy
books.description: A manual for people who already read for others. It goes deeper into how spirit communication works and how a working medium stays safe, connected and confident.

courses.title: Online Mediumship Certificate Course – Level 1
courses.description: The first of three self-paced levels in her online school. Six modules of weekly teachings and homework, with a certificate on completion; levels 2 and 3 follow on.

courses.title: Online Intuition Certificate Course
courses.description: A five-module online course for developing intuition, with weekly lessons and exercises to work through at home. It leads to a certificate of completion.

courses.title: Protection and Energy Clearing Certification
courses.description: A downloadable workshop on keeping your own energy strong and clear, and on clearing the rooms you live or work in. Students send in the exercises, can email her questions, and receive a certificate.

courses.title: 5 Weeks of Meditation Part 1
courses.description: Five guided meditations she recorded, released for download, that turn attention inward to the qualities of the soul and include meeting guides and helpers in spirit. Buyers can email her about what comes up in practice.

courses.title: Soul-Connect Coaching Program – Live Classes over Zoom, Nov 11 – Dec 16, 2026
courses.description: A six-week group programme held live on Zoom. Participants look at the beliefs and habits that keep them stuck, with guided reflection and the support of a small group.

courses.title: Online Reiki Level 1 Certification
courses.description: An online first-degree Reiki course from a Reiki Master/Teacher, worked through at your own pace. Levels 2 and Master Teacher are offered as follow-on courses.
